verses.original: תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ אֱלוֹהַ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: tə·hil·lāh lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ă·rō·w·mim·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·w·hay ham·me·leḵ wa·’ă·ḇā·ră·ḵāh šim·k̲ā lə·‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: A Psalm of praise Of David I will exalt You my God and King I will bless Your name forever and ever
verses.literalPt: Exaltar-te-ei, Deus meu, ó Rei; e bendirei o teu nome para todo o sempre.

verses.original: בְּכָל־ י֥וֹם אֲבָרֲכֶ֑ךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl yō·wm ’ă·ḇā·ră·ḵe·kā wa·’ă·hal·lāh šim·k̲ā lə·‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: Every day I will bless You and I will praise Your name forever and ever
verses.literalPt: Todos os dias te bendirei e louvarei o teu nome para todo o sempre.

verses.original: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝לִגְדֻלָּת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: gā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh ū·mə·hul·lāl mə·’ōḏ wə·liḡ·ḏul·lā·ṯōw ’ên ḥê·qer
verses.literal: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised His greatness is unsearchable
verses.literalPt: Grande é Jeová e mui digno de ser louvado; a sua grandeza é insondável.

verses.original: דּ֣וֹר לְ֭דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃
verses.transliteration: dō·wr lə·ḏō·wr yə·šab·baḥ ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā ū·ḡə·ḇū·rō·ṯe·ḵā yag·gî·ḏū
verses.literal: One generation will commend Your works to the next and will proclaim Your mighty acts
verses.literalPt: Uma geração louvará a outra geração as tuas obras, e anunciarão os teus poderosos atos.

verses.original: הֲ֭דַר כְּב֣וֹד הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וְדִבְרֵ֖י נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ḏar kə·ḇō·wḏ hō·w·ḏe·ḵā wə·ḏiḇ·rê nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā ’ā·śî·ḥāh
verses.literal: the glorious splendor of Your majesty And I will meditate on Your wondrous works
verses.literalPt: No glorioso esplendor da tua majestade e nas tuas maravilhas, meditarei.

verses.original: וֶעֱז֣וּז נוֹרְאֹתֶ֣יךָ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְדוּלֹּתֶיךָ אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: we·‘ĕ·zūz nō·wr·’ō·ṯe·ḵā yō·mê·rū ū·ḡə·ḏūl·lō·ṯɛ·ḵå̄ ’ă·sap·pə·ren·nāh
verses.literal: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds and I will declare Your greatness
verses.literalPt: Falar-se-á do poder dos teus atos tremendos, e contarei a tua grandeza.

verses.original: זֵ֣כֶר רַב־ טוּבְךָ֣ יַבִּ֑יעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: zê·ḵer raḇ- ṭū·ḇə·ḵā yab·bî·‘ū wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā yə·ran·nê·nū
verses.literal: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness
verses.literalPt: Divulgarão a memória da tua muita bondade e com júbilo celebrarão a tua justiça.

verses.original: חַנּ֣וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וּגְדָל־ חָֽסֶד׃
verses.transliteration: ḥan·nūn wə·ra·ḥūm Yah·weh ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim ū·ḡə·ḏāl- ḥā·seḏ
verses.literal: The LORD is gracious and compassionate slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion
verses.literalPt: Benigno e misericordioso é Jeová, tardio em irar-se e de grande clemência.

verses.original: טוֹב־ יְהוָ֥ה לַכֹּ֑ל וְ֝רַחֲמָ֗יו עַל־ כָּל־ מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- Yah·weh lak·kōl wə·ra·ḥă·māw ‘al- kāl- ma·‘ă·śāw
verses.literal: The LORD is good to all His compassion rests on all He has made
verses.literalPt: Bom é Jeová para com todos, e as suas ternas misericórdias estão sobre todas as suas obras.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יךָ יְבָרֲכֽוּכָה׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏū·ḵā Yah·weh kāl- ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā wa·ḥă·sî·ḏe·ḵā yə·ḇā·ră·ḵū·ḵāh
verses.literal: All You have made will give You thanks O LORD and Your saints will bless You
verses.literalPt: Graças te darão, Jeová, todas as tuas obras; e os teus santos te bendirão.

verses.original: כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ֣ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḇō·wḏ mal·ḵū·ṯə·ḵā yō·mê·rū ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯə·ḵā yə·ḏab·bê·rū
verses.literal: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might
verses.literalPt: Falarão da glória do teu reino e confessarão o teu poder,

verses.original: לְהוֹדִ֤יעַ׀ לִבְנֵ֣י הָ֭אָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָ֑יו וּ֝כְב֗וֹד הֲדַ֣ר מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·hō·w·ḏî·a‘ liḇ·nê hā·’ā·ḏām gə·ḇū·rō·ṯāw ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ hă·ḏar mal·ḵū·ṯōw
verses.literal: to make known to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom
verses.literalPt: para darem a conhecer aos filhos dos homens os seus poderosos feitos e a glória da majestade do seu reino.

verses.original: מַֽלְכוּתְךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כָּל־ עֹֽלָמִ֑ים וּ֝מֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ֗ בְּכָל־ דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: mal·ḵū·ṯə·ḵā mal·ḵūṯ kāl- ‘ō·lā·mîm ū·mem·šel·tə·ḵā bə·ḵāl dō·wr wā·ḏō·wr
verses.literal:
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom and Your dominion endures through all generations The LORD is faithful in all His words

and kind in all His actions
verses.literalPt: O teu reino é o de todos os séculos, e o teu domínio subsiste por todas as gerações.

verses.original: סוֹמֵ֣ךְ יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־ הַנֹּפְלִ֑ים וְ֝זוֹקֵ֗ף לְכָל־ הַכְּפוּפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: sō·w·mêḵ Yah·weh lə·ḵāl han·nō·p̄ə·lîm wə·zō·w·qêp̄ lə·ḵāl hak·kə·p̄ū·p̄îm
verses.literal: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down
verses.literalPt: Jeová sustém a todos os que estão caindo e levanta a todos os que estão abatidos.

verses.original: עֵֽינֵי־ כֹ֭ל אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ וְאַתָּ֤ה נֽוֹתֵן־ לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־ אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nê- ḵōl ’ê·le·ḵā yə·śab·bê·rū wə·’at·tāh nō·w·ṯên- lā·hem ’eṯ- ’ā·ḵə·lām bə·‘it·tōw
verses.literal: The eyes of all look to You and You give . . . them their food in season
verses.literalPt: Os olhos de todos em ti estão fitos, e tu lhes dás o alimento a tempo.

verses.original: פּוֹתֵ֥חַ אֶת־ יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ לְכָל־ חַ֣י רָצֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: pō·w·ṯê·aḥ ’eṯ- yā·ḏe·ḵā ū·maś·bî·a‘ lə·ḵāl ḥay rā·ṣō·wn
verses.literal: You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing
verses.literalPt: Abres a mão e satisfazes o desejo de todo vivente.

verses.original: צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־ דְּרָכָ֑יו וְ֝חָסִ֗יד בְּכָל־ מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq Yah·weh bə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵāw wə·ḥā·sîḏ bə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śāw
verses.literal: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds
verses.literalPt: Justo é Jeová em todos os seus caminhos e benigno, em todas as suas obras.

verses.original: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־ קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rō·wḇ Yah·weh lə·ḵāl qō·rə·’āw lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yiq·rā·’u·hū ḇe·’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: The LORD is near to all who call on Him to all who call out to Him in truth
verses.literalPt: Perto está Jeová de todos os que o invocam, de todos os que o invocam em verdade.

verses.original: רְצוֹן־ יְרֵאָ֥יו יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְֽאֶת־ שַׁוְעָתָ֥ם יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ṣō·wn- yə·rê·’āw ya·‘ă·śeh wə·’eṯ- šaw·‘ā·ṯām yiš·ma‘ wə·yō·wō·šî·‘êm
verses.literal: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him He hears their cry and saves them
verses.literalPt: Ele satisfará o desejo dos que o temem e, ouvindo o seu clamor, os salvará,

verses.original: שׁוֹמֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ כָּל־ אֹהֲבָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ הָרְשָׁעִ֣ים יַשְׁמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: šō·w·mêr Yah·weh ’eṯ- kāl- ’ō·hă·ḇāw wə·’êṯ kāl- hā·rə·šā·‘îm yaš·mîḏ
verses.literal: The LORD preserves all who love Him but all the wicked He will destroy
verses.literalPt: Jeová preserva todos os que o amam, mas exterminará todos os perversos.

verses.original: תְּהִלַּ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה יְֽדַבֶּ֫ר־ פִּ֥י וִיבָרֵ֣ךְ כָּל־ בָּ֭שָׂר שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשׁ֗וֹ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: tə·hil·laṯ Yah·weh yə·ḏab·ber- pî wî·ḇā·rêḵ kāl- bā·śār šêm qā·ḏə·šōw lə·‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever
verses.literalPt: A minha boca publicará o louvor de Jeová; e bendiga toda carne o seu santo nome para todo o sempre.
